top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises the pKa-tuned ionizable lipid and its controlled assembly into nanoparticles, a distinct chemical design principle (near-neutral in circulation, cationic and fusogenic in the endosome) that created the delivery capability behind approved siRNA and mRNA medicines and was not covered by the 2023 Medicine prize, which honoured the nucleoside-modified cargo. The Cullis, Hope and Madden allocation and citation are scoped to the principle, leaving lipidoid optimisation unadjudicated; the cut is a judgement I cannot verify from the supplied materials. P001 is a sound, cleanly attributed second choice I could accept, and P003 is mature but a follow-on to the 2010 cross-coupling prize.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my peptide-nanoparticle and hydrogel work is thematically near lipid nanoparticles but involves no collaboration with Cullis, Hope or Madden
